sn4.23:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn4.23:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā godhiko isigilipasse viharati kāḷasilāyaṃ.
sn4.23:1.4: atha kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmāyikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
sn4.23:1.5: atha kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmāyikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.6: dutiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmāyikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
sn4.23:1.7: dutiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmāyikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.8: tatiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmāyikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
sn4.23:1.9: tatiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā. pe. parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.10: catutthampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto. pe. phusi.
sn4.23:1.11: catutthampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā. pe. parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.12: pañcamampi kho āyasmā godhiko. pe. phusi.
sn4.23:1.13: pañcamampi kho āyasmā godhiko. pe. parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.14: chaṭṭhampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmāyikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
sn4.23:1.15: chaṭṭhampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmāyikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
sn4.23:1.16: sattamampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmāyikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
sn4.23:2.2: yāva chaṭṭhaṃ khvāhaṃ sāmāyikāya cetovimuttiyā parihīno
sn4.23:2.4: atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato godhikassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
sn4.23:6.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā godhikena satthaṃ āharitaṃ hoti.
sn4.23:6.2: atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn4.23:8.2: āyāma bhikkhave yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamissāma yattha godhikena kulaputtena satthaṃ āharitanti.
sn4.23:8.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn4.23:9.1: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkami.
sn4.23:9.2: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ godhikaṃ dūratova mañcake vivattakkhandhaṃ seyyamānaṃ.
sn4.23:9.3: tena kho pana samayena dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati uddhaṃ gacchati adho gacchati anudisaṃ.
sn4.23:10.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati uddhaṃ gacchati adho gacchati anudisanti.
sn4.23:10.4: eso kho bhikkhave māro pāpimā godhikassa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṃ samanvesati
sn4.23:10.6: appatiṭṭhitena ca bhikkhave viññāṇena godhiko kulaputto parinibbutoti.
sn4.23:10.7: atha kho māro pāpimā veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
